name: Liliane Sabine Saint-Coeur
source:
Liliane was born into the noble Saint-Coeur family, and her life has been one of pleasure and excess since birth. With wardrobes full of beautiful clothes and maids to attend to her every need, Liliane is spoiled to the extreme, and she has no conception of how ordinary people live.

Haughty and proud to a fault, Liliane regards herself as a perfect being. She looks down upon her subjects – Marius in particular – and, even when threatened with death, she refuses to apologise for any of her supposed sins.

It would be most unseemly for a queen to apologise to a mere commoner, after all.
